# apm-workspace

The authoring checkout (`~/src/github.com/jey3dayo/apm-workspace`) is the working copy and operational source of truth for the global APM workspace of `jey3dayo`. On the native HOME, `~/.apm` holds only the APM consumer state.
It owns the global manifest (`apm.yml`), the lockfile (`apm.lock.yaml`), the cache-only `apm_modules/`, personal skill sources, and the shared runtime guidance package (`catalog/`).

## Where to read

- `README.md`: human overview and day-to-day flow
- `AGENTS.md`: full contract, guardrails, and edit surfaces
- `docs/apm-task-coverage.md`: every `mise` task and what gates it
- `docs/native-distribution.md`: the APM-native `native:*` rollout, rollback, and what stays manual
- `docs/skill-inventory.md`: skill lanes (global, catalog, optional, manual, private, repo-local)
- `docs/skill-overlaps.md`: which of several similar skills to use
- `docs/saas-connectors.md`: SaaS connection placement priority
- `docs/agents-provenance.md`: curated agent sources and distribution
- `docs/diagrams/agent-delegation.md`: delegation flow diagrams and verification status
- `docs/package-decisions.md`: why each package was added, kept, or removed
- `docs/learning-ledger.md`: changes applied by `intake`, graded on whether they worked
- `catalog/.apm/skills/apm-usage/SKILL.md`: operating guidance for agents
- `todo.txt` / `done.txt`: open and finished internal tasks

## Key rules (details in AGENTS.md)

- Edit personal skills in `catalog/.apm/skills/**`, copied skills in `manual-skills/**`, shared guidance in `catalog/**`.
- `private-skills/**` is gitignored here; its source of truth is a private repo.
- Add or remove external skills by editing the root `apm.yml` in the checkout, then regenerating `apm.lock.yaml` with `mise run upgrade:deps` (preview with `-- --dry-run`), reviewing `git diff apm.lock.yaml`, and validating pins and holds (`docs/dependency-holds.txt`) with `mise run validate:workspace`. Do not run `apm install -g` / `apm uninstall -g` for this: on the native HOME they write the consumer `~/.apm` and the real HOME, not the checkout, and the next native rollout drops the change.
- Never edit `apm_modules/` or deployed targets in place.
- The `apm` version is pinned in `mise.toml`; read it there instead of trusting a quoted version.
- Run `mise run check` before pushing; roll out merged commits with `mise run native:sync` (details and rollback in section B of `docs/native-distribution.md`).
